01 / Product Series

From body cleansing
to energy restoration.

The strategy is structured around three post-workout stages: Reset, Recover, and Recharge, creating a complete journey from body cleansing to energy restoration.

Need for cleansing → Reset. Physical fatigue → Recover. Need for relaxation → Recharge.

01 — RESETWHITE ZONE ↘02 — RECOVERBLUE ZONE ↘03 — RECHARGEGREEN ZONE ↘

Reset

Basic Cleansing Products
WHITE ZONE / Basic Cleansing

The Reset Series focuses on consumers’ immediate needs after exercise, including removing sweat, refreshing the skin, and restoring comfort.[06]

Remove sweat. Refresh your skin. Reset your day.PRODUCT NAMES & IMAGERY / PROJECT PDF 06

Recover / Sports Recovery Spray

BLUE ZONE / Sports Recovery Spray

Explore Recover

This series focuses on rapid recovery and physical adjustment, targeting high-frequency activities such as yoga, running, and strength training. The concept incorporates menthol, aloe vera extract, and botanical soothing components.

PRODUCT CONCEPT & VISUAL / PDF 07

Recharge / Essential Oil & Relaxation

GREEN ZONE / Essential Oil & Relaxation

The Recharge Series expands physical recovery into emotional wellness. Through fragrance experiences, plant elements and wooden materials, the concept connects post-workout care with nature, balance and emotional restoration.

PRODUCT CONCEPT & VISUAL / PDF 08

Packaging Strategy

Materiality. Proportion. Portability.

A minimalist design language emphasizes materiality and proportion. Neutral tones and matte finishes create a soft, natural identity. Small capacities, portable formats and replaceable packaging support active lifestyle scenarios.

Product Strategy

Movement + Recovery + Self-care

The strategy evolves from basic care to aromatherapy and lifestyle expansion: functional cleansing, emotional and sensory recovery, and a wider lifestyle ecosystem. [CASE STUDY 12–14]

03 / Marketing Strategy

Recovery City Map.
A wellness lifestyle experience.

“Good energy does not only exist during movement; recovery is also an essential part of a healthy lifestyle.”

Offline city experiences, cross-industry collaborations, and social media seeding introduce the collection. Retail, community activities and ambassadors support long-term engagement. Collaborations and spatial visuals below are design proposals.

Short term marketing campaign

Recovery City Map

Consumers can discover participating yoga studios, premium gyms and wellness cafés through a digital map, experience the relevant products, check in, and receive exclusive samples. [PDF 14–26; CASE STUDY 16–18]

01 / WHITE ZONEPDF 16

RESET × Yoga Studio

PURE Yoga / “RESET After Yoga”
A RESET Station near the changing or relaxation area offers post-class cleansing experiences and travel-size samples.

COLLABORATION & SPATIAL DESIGN PROPOSAL

02 / BLUE ZONEPDF 17–19

RECOVER × Premium Gym

PURE Fitness / “RECOVER 15”

COLLABORATION & SPATIAL DESIGN PROPOSAL

03 / GREEN ZONEPDF 25–26

Wagas / “RECHARGE Corner”

Sales Channels / Digital Marketing

Online Channels Strategy

The official website, mobile application and membership platform support product experiences and personalized recommendations. Fitness influencers, wellness creators and female lifestyle creators share workout routines, product experiences and self-care habits.

DIGITAL CHANNEL PROPOSAL / PDF 10–13

Long term marketing campaign

Recovery Lifestyle Ecosystem

Lululemon can transform Recovery Lab from a new product category into a long-term wellness ecosystem through four key areas: retail experience, community activities, ambassador programs, and digital communication. [PDF 27–31]

RECOVERY EXPERIENCE ZONE / RETAIL DESIGN PROPOSALPDF 28
01 / Retail Experience

Retail Experience Integration

Three differentiated product areas with recovery testing stations, ingredient education displays, fragrance experiences and personalized recovery recommendations. [28]

02 / Community Program

Community-Based Recovery

Weekly Recovery Yoga, recovery workshops, body-care sharing sessions and wellness workshops help build long-term recovery habits. [29]

03 / Ambassador Program

Ambassador Program Expansion

Ambassadors share post-workout recovery routines, self-care habits, and physical and emotional wellbeing practices. [30]

04 / Social Media

Official Social Media Strategy

Instagram: high-end visuals and product spreads. TikTok / Douyin: interactive experience tutorials. Xiaohongshu: community sharing and user experience. [31]
